mockResolution.description: Additive (optional), mock mode only: 'engine' (default) evaluates the deterministic mock policy inside Engine with no worker round trip; 'worker' queues decisions for a worker.

rationale.description: Additive (optional): Engine's deterministic explanation of this decision.

reasoning.description: Additive (optional): reasoning text the behavior model returned, if any. Never parsed.

summary.description: One line, e.g. "Hungry (72/100); Harbor Grill board: 4 min; $38.00 left -> chose ... (p=0.61) over ... (p=0.22)".

drivers.description: What the group noticed or felt, as short factual phrases (needs, wallet, time, waits).

alternatives.description: Up to three most likely other options, most likely first.

modelReasoning.description: The behavior model's own reasoning text when it returned one; otherwise null.

DecisionRationale.description: Additive: a short, human-readable account of one applied decision, built by Engine from the frozen observation, the offered options and the applied distribution (deterministic).

breakdown.description: Additive (optional): per-place and per-state detail at this instant, for dashboards.

states.description: Guests currently in each activity state (states with zero guests are omitted).

revenueCents.description: Cumulative net ancillary revenue attributed to this place (passes count at the ride).

servedGuests.description: Cumulative guests who finished service here (rides, shows, counters).

satisfactionLevels.description: Admitted guests by latest satisfaction rating level (index 0..levels-1; unrated excluded).

MetricBreakdown.description: Additive: dashboard detail carried by each MetricSnapshot (getMetrics series, live metrics).

statusText.description: Additive (optional): plain-language current status, e.g. "Queueing for Sky Coaster (6 min so far)".

decisions.description: Additive (optional): the group's most recent applied decisions (newest first, up to 12).

DecisionSummary.description: Additive: compact history row for the agent inspector (newest first in AgentDetail).
